recheck.ref: 5. Reordered operation logs leave permanently occupied capacity
recheck.evidence: “processing the delayed insertion log admits an entry already removed from the map” identifies stale admission, and “a capacity-one cache rejects a new key” establishes leaked capacity. However, the report does not identify the required unreachable deque node.

recheck.ref: 4. Asynchronous computations release their lock before writing
recheck.evidence: “removes the waiter, and releases its lock before applying the computed operation” explicitly identifies premature waiter release in the future cache. “Another computation can therefore read the same old value and overwrite an update” supplies the required stale-read and lost-update consequence.
